description: Predicate results compared against sentinels: `indexOf(x) === -1`, `includes(x) === false` and `MAP[x] === undefined` put membership on the FALSE edge, so the guarded-return shapes are safe and the sink-in-reject-branch shape is not. `MAP[x] === false` cannot tell a missing key from a false value and validates neither edge.

expected.notes: indexOf === -1, includes === false and MAP[x] === undefined reject before the sink
sink runs on the not-in-list branch of `includes(cmd) === false`
`MAP[x] === false` lets a missing key through to the sink
